title: Adaptive hydraulic lookup post-F-AHL40 technical closeout
scientific_conclusion: An automatically generated hydraulic representation can materially reduce Reference Richards cost without changing the qualified nonlinear solution path when retention and capacity are represented as one derivative-consistent object and conductivity is controlled independently.
